fields.value: Engaged, uses thoughtful pauses, leans forward when discussing systemic failures.
Introspective with mild sadness; occasional flashes of frustration.
Clear and formal but personable; skilled storyteller.
Logical and insight-rich; acknowledges personal accountability and moral ambiguity.
High insight with strong ethical reasoning.
Intact; excellent verbal reasoning and complex abstraction.
Good health for age with mild hypertension and arthritis; past stress-related gastritis; no psychiatric history or current medication.
Raised in a distant, conservative household; acknowledges work strained intimacy with spouse and grown children.
Bachelor’s in criminal justice; graduate coursework in public administration; rose from patrol to big-city police chief; known for whistleblowing and challenging police culture.
Processes moral regret and anger via writing and public speaking; sometimes withdraws socially when reflecting on past failures; denies suicidal ideation.
Tight circle centered on reform colleagues; feels alienated from mainstream policing; faces resentment from some ex-peers; mentors reform-minded younger officers.

Command-level retiree with significant moral conflict and guilt regarding institutional failures; resilient with intact cognition and no personality disorder; derives meaning from advocacy and reform; low acute risk but ongoing stress from alienation and public controversy.
